title: Information Gathering And Conclusion System
mission: Turn public-source leads into useful, evidence-bounded conclusions that help readers understand power, policy, money, identity, institutions, missing records and convergence routes without confusing speculation for proof.

pipeline.title: Collect
pipeline.rule: Gather source links, official pages, filings, public records, archives, reader leads, card forum submissions and daily public drops.

pipeline.title: Classify
pipeline.rule: Tag each item by lane, actor, jurisdiction, date, evidence level, source class, affected deck/cards and missing records.

pipeline.title: Grade Evidence
pipeline.rule: Separate official records, primary documents, reliable reporting, commentary, speculation, contradiction and unsupported claims.

pipeline.title: Cross-check
pipeline.rule: Compare against counter-sources, corrections, older records, duplicate claims, outdated pages and source conflicts.

pipeline.title: Connect
pipeline.rule: Route source material to clocks, cards, policies, institutions, people, think tanks, books, videos and user briefs.

pipeline.title: Conclude
pipeline.rule: Produce conclusion, why it matters, evidence boundary, confidence, missing record, and next action.

pipeline.title: Publish
pipeline.rule: Expose the conclusion through Daily Brief, Live Intel, card dossiers, risk clocks, search routes and downloads.

pipeline.title: Review
pipeline.rule: Re-check stale conclusions, process reader corrections and downgrade or archive unsupported items.

evidenceLevels.label: Lead
evidenceLevels.meaning: Interesting source or claim, not enough to conclude.

evidenceLevels.label: Public mention
evidenceLevels.meaning: Speech, article, webpage, interview, report or claim with a visible source.

evidenceLevels.label: Primary source
evidenceLevels.meaning: Official page, filing, legislation, public record, court material, regulator notice or original document.

evidenceLevels.label: Implementation
evidenceLevels.meaning: Procurement, pilot, legal mandate, enforcement action, operational rollout or signed agreement.

evidenceLevels.label: Convergence
evidenceLevels.meaning: Two or more systems connect, such as ID plus payments, health plus travel, AI plus public services.

evidenceLevels.label: Lock-in signal
evidenceLevels.meaning: Opt-out becomes difficult, access becomes conditional, or infrastructure becomes unavoidable.

qualityRules: No [object Object] visible in public pages.
No internal author notes, debug text or prompt text visible to users.
No source link, no ledger entry.
No conclusion without an evidence boundary.
No score movement without a dated source route.
No relationship entry presented as guilt or proof.
Every intake area needs action, boundary and correction route.
Every public brief needs next action and missing-record path.
